Latterday Saints live there, compared with 450 in 1950 and 11 in 1935. Alaska Stake, which extends

Ever wonder what it's like to be a Mormon in America's last frontier? It's like great—just being a Mormon anywhere—but

in Alaska there are some special twists and challenges.

Teenagers in Alaska have many of the same interests as their peers in Florida, Maine,

Utah, or other areas They'love to play the latest pop tunes, dance the newest dances, wear the current fashions, munch hamburgers (and sometimes mooseburgers )—and

they have loads of energy for school and Church activities.
